cell: logical 1x1x1 on 0.55 m grid; mount = Socket_Mount_Bottom

R4W_Shotgun_ROOT.style: R41_Turret_v6.1 standard (heavy industrial armour + team colour)

Socket_Mount_Bottom.role: mounting face centre, normal -Y, connects to cell (0,-1,0)

R4W_Shotgun_Yaw.role: Yaw: rotate around local Y only

R4W_Shotgun_Pitch.role: Pitch: rotate around local X only

R4W_Shotgun_Barrels.role: recoiling 6-bore choke block: slides back along local -Z

R4W_Shotgun_Pump.role: pump fore-end, child of block: slides back along local -Z and returns

R4W_Shotgun_LoadingGate.role: top loading gate: rotates about local Z (hinge on its +X edge), opens to 100 deg

Muzzle.role: single logical salvo origin (8 pellets in gameplay)

visible_exits_note: 6 visible bores in one choke block = 1 logical Muzzle; gameplay pellets (8) are NOT tied to bore count
notes: Choke block front 0.410 m, Muzzle 0.450 m forward of the pivot.
